Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was driving slowly through a residential stretch in Baytown, Texas, when the car in front of me stopped short and I
could not avoid it. My vehicle and the other car came together nose to nose at low speed, and the impact was not
severe enough to deploy the airbags. Within a few minutes I noticed a stiff, aching pain at the back of my neck, and
by the next morning my head turned only with effort. I went to be checked, was told I had a neck strain, and have
been following the treatment plan since. Looking back over my recollection, I have added a few minor details as they
came back to me, such as the exact position of the other vehicle, but the core sequence of events has stayed the
same from the start. I am the named driver on the policy, and I am providing this account so the claim can be
processed.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
